summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in the ControlCode union. rich/control.py adds the formatting entry (\x1b]0;{title}\x07) and the Control.title classmethod with a docstring. rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) -> bool beside show_cursor, gated only on is_terminal, with a Google-style docstring. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one SET_WINDOW_TITLE branch calling term.set_title(title). CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added: test_control_title in tests/test_control.py, test_set_window_title (skipped on Windows) in tests/test_console.py, and test_control_set_window_title (Windows-only, mocked) in tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Caveat: I did not run tests, Black, or mypy, per the instructions; all verification was by reading. Nothing was committed.
